snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order -  Ordeal Call III: Bellum Novae Humanitatis, Archetype Inception Full Ver. Trailer
snippet.description:
In the city of the future without mortality or strife, a showdown with the "Final Boss" begins!

"I'm afraid there's no one left on Earth."

A kindred world that has reached its goal.
In the city of the future without mortality or strife, an unavoidable doom will be defined.

As they multiply out of control, Moon Cancers compete in a grand election for the world's highest honor. Expose the cancer festering in the heart of the many schemes on the moon.

"Bellum Novae Humanitatis, Archetype Inception"

The true enemy threatens the moon. Its name is...

Learn more at https://fate-go.us/archetype_inception/
